post.description: Creates a private API key for the current user.

delete.description: Deletes a private API key owned by the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns all private API keys created by the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates a workspace-scoped API key for users allowed to manage workspace API keys.

delete.description: Deletes a workspace-scoped API key by ID.

get.description: Returns the API keys created for the selected workspace.
Resolves a private download token for the authenticated file owner and redirects to the download URL.
Resolves a public share token and either redirects or proxies the file content.

delete.description: Deletes a file from the authenticated user's personal storage.
Deletes several personal files in one request.

post.description: Moves a personal file from one path to another.
Creates a public share token for a personal file.

get.description: Returns all files shared with the current user.

post.description: Marks a received share as seen by token.

get.description: Returns how many received shares have not yet been marked as seen.

post.description: Shares one or more personal files with another user, optionally emailing the recipient.

get.description: Returns all files that the current user has shared with others.
Returns the authenticated user's personal file tree for a given path prefix.

post.description: Uploads a file to the current user's personal storage and optionally stores it in a folder.

get.description: Returns the note content for a file checksum.

put.description: Updates or creates the note for a file checksum.

delete.description: Deletes a personal folder and optionally all nested files and folders when recursive is true.

get.description: Returns the folders that exist at the supplied personal path.

post.description: Moves a personal folder to another path.

get.description: Returns public metadata for a share token without requiring authentication.

post.description: Resolves a public share token and returns a signed download URL.
Revokes a previously created public share token.

delete.description: Deletes the authenticated user's account and optionally keeps or removes bucket data.

get.description: Returns the current user's bucket metadata and usage details.
Returns the authenticated user's profile and plan details.

post.description: Generates a download token for a private file name.

get.description: Returns aggregate file, share, and workspace statistics for the current user.

post.description: Creates a new workspace using the authenticated user's account.

delete.description: Deletes a workspace owned by the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns pending invites for a workspace when the caller is allowed to view them.

post.description: Accepts a workspace invite token for the authenticated user.
Creates a workspace invite for a specific email and role.

delete.description: Deletes a pending workspace invite when the caller can manage the workspace.

get.description: Returns all workspace invites associated with the authenticated user.

delete.description: Rejects a workspace invite using its token.

get.description: Returns all workspaces visible to the authenticated user.
Returns the members of a workspace when the caller has access to it.

delete.description: Removes a member from a workspace when the caller has permission.

patch.description: Updates the role of a workspace member when the caller has permission to manage members.
Updates the name and optionally the slug of a workspace owned by the current user.

delete.description: Deletes a workspace file when the caller has write access.

get.description: Creates a signed download URL for a workspace file and redirects or proxies based on mode.

delete.description: Deletes a workspace folder when the caller has write access.

patch.description: Moves a folder to a new location inside the workspace.

post.description: Creates a new folder inside the selected workspace.

patch.description: Moves a file to another path within the same workspace.

get.description: Returns the file tree for a workspace path visible to the caller.

post.description: Uploads a file into a workspace folder for users with write access.

get.description: Returns storage, file, folder, member, and API key quota information for a workspace.
